baselines.B0_no_memory: fixed retry with no historical experiences
baselines.B1_nearest_neighbor: single closest experience, historical action copy, same safety gate, execution, validation
baselines.B2_memory_planner: canonical FailureMemory plus Diagnosis plus RuleBasedRecoveryPlanner
baselines.B3_observable_feature: nearest action centroid using observable features only

leakage_controls: factor IDs and optimal actions exist only in protocol/evaluation harness
runtime observations contain only feature vectors, generic error evidence, and safety constraints
evaluation outcomes are never inserted before each decision
training experiences are fixed before evaluation
memory order is explicitly shuffled by deterministic permutations
B1 receives exactly one closest event and does not run diagnosis or multi-event aggregation
no model or calibrator is fabricated
previous result directories are never written
protocol.max_attempts_policy: one attempt intentionally isolates action-selection and evidence-composition effects; no replanning benefit is claimed in this protocol
